verdict.rationale: Sentry documents rule-based alerts that fire on issues from projects or Monitors and deliver to notifications, tickets, webhooks, and integrations such as Slack channels and PagerDuty, which gives basic routing. The evidence does not show alerting on every telemetry signal, such as metrics, traces, or logs, nor any notification grouping or silencing. Missing for 10: alerting on any signal type (traces/logs/metrics), notification grouping/deduplication controls, silencing/muting/snooze of alerts, documented routing policies, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can alert on any telemetry signal with routing, grouping, and silencing of notifications

citations.quote: Sentry's Alerts take action when issues in your organization match pre-defined rules. An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations
An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations for issues coming from projects or Monitors.
Send a notification to your team's Slack channel when a new issue is created.
Get paged by important issues with PagerDuty.
